name: K-pop Dance
notes: K-pop Dance style pack (Doc 04 template) with the pack's own legal-honesty rule (Doc 06 posture, applied): moves and methods are free vocabulary, but FULL K-POP ROUTINES ARE CHOREOGRAPHED WORKS — a choreographer's copyrighted creation. So this pack teaches the SKILLS of K-pop dance, never a specific group's routine: kalgunmu (칼군무, 'knife group dance') precision, sharpness and dynamics control, isolations, formation awareness, facial performance, and stamina. meta.choreo_honesty states the rule and routes covers where they belong — official dance-practice videos, learned with the choreographer credited. Culture told straight: ignited by Seo Taiji and Boys (1992), built by idol agencies and a professional choreographer class (studios like 1MILLION made choreographers famous in their own right); the trainee system's intensity is acknowledged honestly, and this pack's healthy-practice framing is the opposite of it. Technique parents credited: hip hop, jazz and commercial choreo — cross-linked to this app's own packs. The social scene is real and delightful: cover crews and RANDOM PLAY DANCE events worldwide.

seasons.finale: Film an 8-count of original sharp choreo-style movement — clean stops, controlled dynamics, no mush.
Film the isolation tower — head, shoulders, ribs, hips — each floor moving alone, on beat.
Film the same 8-count twice: once blank-faced, once performing. The difference IS the lesson.
Learn one section from an official dance-practice video — credit the group AND the choreographer on camera.
Find a K-pop random play dance event or cover crew near you — or host a living-room one. The scene is the point.

attributes.name: Stop control L1
attributes.test: 10 full-arm swings that stop DEAD at exact points — no bounce, no drift, both arms

attributes.name: Choreo stamina L2
attributes.test: three full songs of continuous marked choreography without form collapsing

attributes.name: Sequence memory L1
attributes.test: hold a 32-count original movement sequence in your body for 48 hours and reproduce it clean

nodes.name: Pop structure — verse, pre, drop, point
checkpoints: K-pop songs are engineered in sections: verse, pre-chorus build, chorus drop — the choreography breathes with them
the POINT MOVE lives on the hook: the one move the whole world learns from every hit
count 8s through a full title track and mark the section changes out loud

nodes.name: Dynamics — sharp, smooth, and the space between
checkpoints: K-pop choreography lives on contrast: knife-sharp hits against liquid grooves, big against small
verse can whisper so the chorus can shout — flat dynamics is the #1 cover-dance mistake
study one performance video with the sound OFF and watch the dynamics alone

nodes.name: Seo Taiji to the world stage
checkpoints: modern K-pop ignited with Seo Taiji and Boys (1992) — Korean pop fused with hip hop, and dance moved to the center
idol agencies industrialized training; a professional choreographer class rose with the industry — studios like 1MILLION made choreographers stars in their own right
K-pop dance stands on hip hop, jazz and commercial choreo — this app's own Hip Hop and Jazz packs are its technique parents

nodes.name: Credit culture — the choreographer has a name
checkpoints: every routine you love was made by a person — find the choreographer's name; the industry increasingly credits them and so does the cover scene
agencies publish official dance-practice videos precisely so fans can learn — that's the sanctioned door
a cover posted with the group AND choreographer credited is the scene's good citizenship

nodes.name: The trainee system — admired honestly
checkpoints: idol precision comes from years of full-time training — respect the craft without romanticizing the system's well-documented intensity
you are not a trainee: this pack's sustainable daily practice is the opposite model, on purpose
steal the WORK ETHIC (drill, film, review), not the schedule

nodes.name: The legal-honesty rule: routines are someone's copyrighted work
checkpoints: dance MOVES and METHODS are free vocabulary — but a full routine is a choreographic WORK, protected like a song; this app will never teach you a group's routine as its own content
this pack teaches the skills; covers are learned from OFFICIAL dance-practice videos, with credit — that's the door the industry itself opened
the same rule protects the dances this app does teach — respect flows both directions

nodes.name: Sharpness — hits, stops, and knife lines
nodes.anchor: the signature K-pop skill — kalgunmu starts here
checkpoints: every movement has an exact endpoint: arm lines finish at angles you could photograph
the stop is dead — no bounce-back, no drift (popping's dime stop is a cousin; this app teaches it too)
drill 8-counts of original sharp movement at half tempo, then full — precision before speed, always
film front-on and check your lines against your intention
mistakes: mushy endpoints — 90% of the move, 10% of the effect

nodes.name: The isolation tower
checkpoints: head, shoulders, ribcage, hips — each floor of the tower moves while the others hold
slides, pops and circles per floor; jazz technique is the parent here
stack two floors moving against each other — that's where choreo texture comes from
mistakes: the whole tower swaying when one floor moves

nodes.name: Formation & spacing awareness (solo drill)
checkpoints: mark floor spots and hit them mid-phrase — K-pop choreography is danced ON a map
practice 'center swaps': travel during two counts, arrive already dancing
kalgunmu is spacing as much as timing; a solo dancer drills it with tape on the floor

nodes.name: Facial performance & camera presence
checkpoints: the face is choreographed too: soft verse, fierce chorus, the look-to-camera on the point move
practice to your phone camera lens, not the mirror — the lens is the audience
one 8-count, three takes, three different characters — flexibility beats one frozen 'performance face'

nodes.name: Marking & full-out — the two practice gears
checkpoints: marking (small, low-energy, brain-focused) is how sequences enter the body; full-out is how they become performance
the pro ratio: many marked reps, few full-out reps, always film the full-outs
never full-out what you can't yet mark cleanly

nodes.name: Your original 32 counts — filmed
checkpoints: choreograph 32 original counts in K-pop style: sharp hits, one isolation moment, one point-move-worthy hook, performed to camera
making your own is the ultimate proof the SKILLS transferred — and it's yours, copyright and all
watch it back with the sound off for dynamics

nodes.name: The credited cover + the scene
checkpoints: learn one section from an OFFICIAL dance-practice video; if you post it, credit the group and the choreographer
find a random play dance event or cover crew near you — the scene runs worldwide and welcomes everyone
notice what the crowd does when a point move hits: that's a whole planet dancing alone, together
